lines.quote: Phased-array signal processing: designed and simulated 16-element and 64-element receive beamforming architectures for X-band and Ku-band radar applications using custom MATLAB tooling and validated against measured array data.
Implemented the range-compression and azimuth-focusing kernels in C++ for a real-time SAR image processor running on a custom FPGA/DSP hybrid board (Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+).
Developed and maintained Tundra-QA, a Python quality-assurance and regression-testing framework for the SAR processor product line.

Responsible for the company’s semi-annual calibration campaigns using Keysight PNA-X vector network analysers and N9040B spectrum analysers, including S-parameter measurement, gain flatness verification, and noise-figure characterisation across temperature in a controlled RF test facility.
Kallavesi University of Technology — MSc, Electrical Engineering, 2006

Kalman filtering and estimation theory: designed and tuned an extended Kalman filter for multi-sensor target tracking in a coastal-surveillance radar prototype, validated against recorded ship-traffic data from a Baltic Sea field trial (2020).
When Tuulikallio won the Polarfront coastal-radar contract in 2019, I was asked to lead the five-person signal-processing team for the programme.
English (professional working language since 2007; all technical documentation, design reviews, and customer communication at Tuulikallio is conducted in English)
my partner’s family is from Oulu, and we have been planning a move north for the past year.
